The separate Northern authority wait data uses one complete source run; repeated scrape runs are not added and percentiles are not averaged.

opportunities.view: Source-pattern map with route/service-day filters, town/facility precision and the original event table; 58 location groups and 28 schematic segments across 26 recorded legs.
opportunities.readiness: Implemented 286 source events, exactly reconciled between original CSV and read-only SQLite table: 280 located and 6 unresolved. The 56 reference points and 28 schematic segments retain source order, collapse adjacent repeated coordinates and require all segment events to remain visible.
risks: Town representatives are not boarding addresses; facility/address references do not establish exact boarding doors or historical pickup positions.
Bundled UHNBC/KL and Terrace hospital/medical-centre source labels receive town context only, not an assumed single facility.
Mackenzie Junction and Small River (Rest Area) remain unlocated, accounting for 6 original events.
Source direction strings encode service-day text, including asterisks. Sequence resets preserve source legs; arrival/departure rows remain separate events.
Connections are schematic source-order links, not actual road routes, distances, speeds or measured journey times.
Source event counts are not passengers, unique trips, bus departures or service frequency; no observed NHHR travel benefit is inferred.
A filtered segment is retained only when all its event_ids remain visible; summaries and underlying event records overlap.
